clock_scope: Host observer entry at final prompt forward completion to first token/byte callback entry; total request API entry through return includes encoding and bounded collector bookkeeping. No extra GPU calls/fences/logit copies or reference IO in callbacks.
preparation: Model/codec/session preparation calls occur outside timer. Any dynamic allocation or readiness required by API execution remains inside the request interval.

correctness.source_control: Unchanged numerical --text/--predict-text controls compare every actual input ID and last F32 word
correctness.timing: Timing run comparisons happen after stop: all encoded/actual input IDs and generated IDs/chunks/bytes. Timing callbacks do not copy/check F32 vectors.
correctness.synthetic: Wrong callback order, geometry, vocab, backwards/NaN clocks, output bounds, empty token/UTF8 flush availability, missing/duplicate flush and duplicate finish reject

observations.interpretation: Post-prompt output delay improves, but overall request time is not universally faster. Retained cache populations differ; the prediction run uploads more on later requests. Prefill remains the main measured cost.

performance_plan.scope: Prepared model/codec/session. API entry through API return, including prompt encoding and bounded callback recording; reference verification and counter snapshots outside timer.
performance_plan.analysis: Report first request separately, then medians of passes1..3. Main phase metric is final-prompt completion callback to first token/byte callback. Total request/prefill are descriptive, not causal speedups.
limitations: Host-clock observer entry timestamps; no GPU kernel duration or stdout/network delivery claim
Existing full-logit source controls are separate; timing runs validate encoded/input IDs and output IDs/chunks/bytes after timer
Expert stores start empty in each process, then persist naturally; retained cache contents differ with omitted final forward
Identical prompt replay is not general cache hit rate; filesystem warmth and GPU clocks uncontrolled
No matched vLLM, concurrency or serving-tail qualification

qualification.scope: Prepared native text timing recorder and benchmark; source comparisons outside timed callbacks, existing numerical text controls unchanged, actual timing recorder exercised under ASAN; no vLLM performance claim

limits: Callbacks indicate availability to an API consumer, not stdout/network delivery
Benchmark context1280 and 48/1024 expert-triple quotas differ from CLI defaults; no exact CLI latency claim
Natural later-pass caches differ between modes after omitted final forward; no identical-cache or general request-hit-rate claim
Identical prompt replay, uncontrolled filesystem warmth/clocks, three later samples per configuration; no sustained-serving or tail claim
No matched vLLM parity or whole-goal completion
expert_upload_ms is the existing host-side upload counter, not an isolated GPU transfer or exposed-stall measurement; it must not be added to overlapping request phases
Explicit EXL3/INT4 BF16 lookup to Exllama F16 Engram adapter, not original Diffbot full-runtime equivalence
Historical driver watchdog remains preserved in parent evidence; this run does not establish a driver fix
